title: Hourly weather — iPad portrait
evidence_kind: simulator screenshot; synthetic/bundled data; no live integration
trigger: Dedicated iPad simulator, storage cleared, Seoul selected from Start, then $state.go
notes: Portrait only: the harness Info.plist allows portrait, so landscape is not captured. TabCtrl.initSize computes sizes once from window.screen. The daily chart takes the bodyWidth >= 640 branch and starts at its first day; the hourly guard compares NaN < 640 and never triggers, so the hourly chart is scrolled like a phone (decision register A49).
